description.value: BNA Brewing Co. & Eatery is Kelowna's flagship craft brewery, set inside a century-old building that once housed the British North American Tobacco Company — the source of the BNA name. All beer is brewed on-site and spans a wide range of styles from easy-drinking lagers to adventurous sours, served alongside a full kitchen menu in a space that also includes bowling lanes. It is a lively, locally-owned destination in the heart of downtown Kelowna, operating since 2015.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms the Kelowna flagship at 1250 Ellis Street, Kelowna, BC V1Y1Z4 with phone (236) 420-0025, matching the OSM tag +1-236-420-0025. The site documents active on-site brewing, a full eatery, growler fills and 4-packs (takeout evidence), and bowling lanes under one roof. No bike parking, water refill, Wi-Fi, or any other cycle-specific amenities are mentioned anywhere on the website or in OSM tags.
